paragraphs.text: Oglor is a homunculus on Innistrad , who works as a lab assistant to Ludevic of Ulm and his apprentice Geralf Cecani .
Oglor is a loyal stitcher's assistant. Ludevic has revived him at least once. He can create other homunculi , though he only does so while his masters are away.
Oglor is likely based on Igor , an archetypal laboratory assistant who is best known for using lightning to help Victor Frankenstein create life.
